siegrist2022_testing.title: Probability, Mathematical Statistics, and Stochastic Processes, §9.1: Introduction to Hypothesis Testing

shared_changes.description: At the Type I/II definition, replace 'accept H0 when H1 is true' with 'fail to reject H0 when H1 is true'; locate the supporting citation in Siegrist §9.1, Errors. Verify all dependent pages including Type I and type II errors, power function and hypothesis tests.
